behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Fragmented header/payload, zero-length record and finish detecting truncation.
Reserved-tag error is transactional and a corrected chunk can complete prior pending data.
docDelivery: Three-byte header with big-endian length, reserved tag and size limits.
Transactional push, non-clearing finish failure and detached byte-view ownership.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Records {type,data}: type integer 0..255 (0 rejected), Uint8Array data including subviews; lengths >65535 rejected. Chunk Uint8Array, finite total <=1MB. Raw stream may contain reserved zero tag or truncation.
independence: Implement length-prefixed binary field serialization with unknown byte-tag preservation and strict truncated-input errors.
